verdict.rationale: Shopify documents several official MCP servers for agents: Global Catalog, Storefront Catalog, Cart, Checkout and Order MCP, served over UCP at catalog.shopify.com and each shop's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint. Runtime probes confirmed live JSON-RPC initialize handshakes on both the global and storefront endpoints, a real keyless cart created through the CLI, and the documented profile gate rejecting an unprofiled request. Missing for 10: no hands-on verification of the authenticated Checkout/Order MCP tools (Token-tier only), and the earlier /api/mcp catalog/cart tools were removed, showing surface churn.
